PHYSICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Thermionic emission and its applications ● Production of cathode rays and their ? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Thermionic emission and its applications ● Production of cathode rays and their .
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Thermionic emission and its applications ● Production of cathode rays and their .
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Thermionic emission and its applications ● Production of cathode rays and their .
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Thermionic emission and its applications ● Production of cathode rays and their .

5. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

6. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. newton (N)
   D. watt (W)

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Capacitors 3.2 Magnetic effect of electric current 3.3 Diodes 4.0 Environmental ? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Capacitors 3.2 Magnetic effect of electric current 3.3 Diodes 4.0 Environmental .
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Capacitors 3.2 Magnetic effect of electric current 3.3 Diodes 4.0 Environmental .
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Capacitors 3.2 Magnetic effect of electric current 3.3 Diodes 4.0 Environmental .
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Capacitors 3.2 Magnetic effect of electric current 3.3 Diodes 4.0 Environmental .

8. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 50 °C

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electromagnetic waves ● Production, properties, detection and applications of el? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electromagnetic waves ● Production, properties, detection and applications of el.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electromagnetic waves ● Production, properties, detection and applications of el.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Electromagnetic waves ● Production, properties, detection and applications of el.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electromagnetic waves ● Production, properties, detection and applications of el.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Magnetic effect of electric current ● Magnetization and demagnetization . ● Magn? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Magnetic effect of electric current ● Magnetization and demagnetization . ● Magn.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Magnetic effect of electric current ● Magnetization and demagnetization . ● Magn.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Magnetic effect of electric current ● Magnetization and demagnetization . ● Magn.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Magnetic effect of electric current ● Magnetization and demagnetization . ● Magn.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dimensional analysis ● Confirming the correctness of formulae and units involvin? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dimensional analysis ● Confirming the correctness of formulae and units involvin.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dimensional analysis ● Confirming the correctness of formulae and units involvin.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Dimensional analysis ● Confirming the correctness of formulae and units involvin.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dimensional analysis ● Confirming the correctness of formulae and units involvin.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Refraction of light ● Verification of laws of refraction of light. ● Determinati? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Refraction of light ● Verification of laws of refraction of light. ● Determinati.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Refraction of light ● Verification of laws of refraction of light. ● Determinati.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Refraction of light ● Verification of laws of refraction of light. ● Determinati.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Refraction of light ● Verification of laws of refraction of light. ● Determinati.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Linear Motion ● Terminologies used in linear motion. (distance, displacement, sp and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Projectile Motion ● Free fall. ● Projectile motion ● . ● Trajectory motion. ● Ac and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
